# 1.0.1r9

Small changes after `1.0.1r7`, as the changelog's rule says: `1.0.1r8` and `1.0.1r9`. `pyproject.toml` already says `1.0.1r9`.

## 1.0.1r9 — 2026-10-31

- A `.tbk` or `.sbk` opens where its ZZZTBKBOOKLOC resource says the book starts. `load()` refused every real book, because it looked for 0x22222222 at 0xC00 and a real book has `03 4A 42 4F` there. Some books start at 0xE00. ToolBook Instructor 8 `blank.tbk` is one. (#4)
- A quiz page reads its own question number, not the bank it was copied from.
- A group whose visible bit is clear hides what is in it. An object whose visible bit is clear is read and marked hidden, so a script that shows it has something to show (#3). An object keeps the names of the groups it is in (#2).

## 1.0.1r8 — 2026-10-25

- The page index is read at six bytes an entry, one per page table. It was read at eight, so every table after the first was lost, and a book with an empty first table listed no pages. A bad table handle is skipped instead of raising.

## Next release point

The next `rN` when a reader fix merges (for example #5, stroke, paint order and hotword spans). A release PR adds `.github/release-notes/<tag>.md`; merging it publishes the release.
